checklist.do: report L with two-sided displacement and, where applicable, AUC, and explain any disagreement (e.g., SWAP, Table tab:x1 ); where an editor's rule is public, run a rule-aware adversary too.
give paraphrasing and in-place editors the same reference, and report first-named and other subjects separately.
report every adversary used, including any that reverses a result, say whether it knows the editing rule, and report both conventions for declined answers.
separate reversals from changes in separability, give each non-separable comparison's minimum detectable difference, and validate content measures.

census.note: 41 model IDs, the GPT-5 line and the 5.6 tiers, probed once each for less than 0.01 USD. Reasoning-first models refuse log-probabilities outright; the pro tiers answer only on a different endpoint. Five IDs are listed as untested because they were rejected by our own top_logprobs: 20 and never retried at 5 -- the same mistake that first hid three usable models.

models.note: Prices are the constants this project's estimators use, in USD per million tokens; check them against the provider's current price list before trusting a total. Capability is measured, and it decides the menu: a model that will not return log-probabilities cannot run this protocol at any price.
